annotation.title_clean: 交通运输部关于做好2024年交通运输防汛防台风工作的通知
annotation.title_en: Ministry of Transport Notice on Doing a Good Job of Transportation Flood Control and Typhoon Prevention in 2024
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 交通运输部 (Ministry of Transport of China)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese Ministry of Transport notice (April 2024) directing transport authorities to prepare for the 2024 flood and typhoon season through responsibility allocation, hazard inspection, early warning, emergency command and reporting across highways, ports, road transport, urban transit and maritime search and rescue. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Transport authorities must assign responsibilities and plan flood and typhoon preparedness.
Hazard inspection with closed-loop rectification and tracking lists is required.
Sector-specific measures cover highways, construction sites, ports, road transport, urban transit, search and rescue, and maritime affairs.
24-hour duty and leadership on-duty systems are mandated.
Provincial bodies must report preparedness to the Ministry by 6 May 2024.
